item.title: John Lee urges continued reform as new public housing maintenance unit launches
item.description: A new group tasked with overseeing building maintenance in Hong Kong has been established to replace the Housing Bureau’s disgraced Independent Checking Unit (ICU), which was deemed culpable for a litany of failings leading up to last year’s Tai Po fire. item.title: Turkish authorities search for lioness spotted on Istanbul’s outskirts
item.description: Police and animal welfare teams in Istanbul are searching for a lioness seen prowling the city’s outskirts, according to Turkish officials. A resident spotted the animal on Sunday evening in Uskumrukoy, an upmarket neighbourhood on the northern edge of Istanbul’s European side, surrounded by forests. item.title: China-US ties to enter ‘more difficult’ 2027 but broad stability will hold: expert
item.description: China-US ties will remain broadly stable in 2027 despite “more confrontational dynamics” and rising tensions, a leading Beijing expert says. item.title: ‘Nothing came through’: why Boeing failed to land firm orders during Trump’s Shenzhen trip
